title: Claude Meetings
lede: Anthropic's Claude Meetings puts Claude into a Google Meet call as a visible attendee that takes questions by voice or chat, writes the notes, and builds shared documents while the team talks.

points: Claude joins the call as a named participant, and anyone can ask it something aloud or in the meeting chat.
It records notes and action items itself, so nobody on the call has to keep minutes.
During the call it can create docs and whiteboards that invited teammates edit live.
With permission it queries connected tools, for example pulling last year's event cost and comparing it with the plan being drafted.
Afterwards the notes, transcript and any artifacts sit on a meeting page in Claude, where you can ask about past meetings you attended.

sections.text: Teams on Claude's Team and Enterprise plans that meet on Google Meet and want notes, follow-ups and planning documents produced during the call rather than after it.
